prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production 2D exercise sprite sheet for WALL PUSH-UP. Transparent background, clean flat illustrated adult fitness characters, consistent anatomy, crisp outlines and subtle cel shading. Exactly 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows, generous transparent gutters, no grid lines. Top row same adult woman in all 3 frames; bottom row same adult man in all 3 frames. Each wears a modest athletic t-shirt with the exact clearly readable clothing brand "Wellness 2.0", athletic bottoms and sneakers. Full bodies and a simple vertical wall visible in each cell. Side three-quarter camera fixed throughout: frame 1 standing inclined toward wall with palms on wall at shoulder height, arms extended; frame 2 elbows flexed halfway as straight body approaches wall; frame 3 elbows bent chest close to wall, feet remain fixed. Same character scale, wall position and foot anchor in every column. Woman and man perform identical movement. No titles, labels, arrows, watermarks or other brands. Output a single landscape PNG sprite sheet.

Edit this wall push-up sprite sheet. Preserve the six poses, characters, clothes and 3-column 2-row layout. Remove ALL background gradients, glows, shadows and scenery to real transparent alpha, retaining only the people and wall supports. Correct all clothing branding to exactly "Wellness 2.0" in white plain sans-serif lettering, no duplicate words or numbers. Wherever the torso faces camera show the exact readable brand on the shirt side panel. No other text. Flat clean 2D sprite artwork, not a poster.
